evidence.title: Equinix 2025 Annual Report (Form 10-K)
evidence.excerpt: Equinix's Form 10-K lists LG4 phase 1, BK1 phase 1, JH2 phases 1 and 2, and SG6 phase 1 in its table of significant IBX data center projects under construction as of December 31, 2025.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of the exact 4071886-byte content-decoded official Inline XBRL HTML response body
metadata.capture_headers_scope: SHA-256 of the exact 2615-byte raw HTTP response-header capture
metadata.retrieval_method: Exact official content-decoded Inline XBRL HTML response body and separate raw response headers captured with HTTP content compression enabled; no request-start artifact was supplied, so none is inferred.
metadata.retrieved_at_semantics: The evidence retrieved_at equals the exact response HTTP Date for this capture.
metadata.construction_table_heading_as_reported: significant IBX data center projects under construction as of December 31, 2025
metadata.status_scope: The table heading supports one generic phase-project under_construction observation for each of the four table rows as of 2025-12-31. It establishes no more specific physical stage, construction-start date, commissioning, completion, or operation.
metadata.target_date_guardrail: Target-open quarters are forward-looking table fields and remain evidence metadata. They create no commissioning or operational lifecycle observation.
metadata.cabinet_guardrail: Sellable cabinets are units of marketable space subject to power limitations, not MW, current load, energy use, building count, or physical construction progress. They create no capacity or lifecycle row.
metadata.capex_guardrail: The filing says capital expenditures are approximate and may change based on final construction details. Dollar values remain row-specific evidence metadata and create no capacity, ownership, investor, or progress observation.
metadata.jh2_combined_row_guardrail: The filing provides one combined JH2 phases 1 and 2 row. It supports exactly one combined project and one lifecycle observation; it does not support separate phase 1 and phase 2 entities, status rows, cabinet allocations, capex allocations, or opening targets.
metadata.bk1_program_scope_guardrail: A separate Thailand announcement's approximately US$500 million ten-year investment and more than 3,375 cabinets across two Bangkok data centers are program and full-build aggregates, not BK1 phase 1 attributes. They are not evidence inputs here and are not allocated or normalized to BK1.
metadata.sg6_capacity_guardrail: The separately reported 20 MW value applies to SG6 when fully built, is not a phase 1 allocation, and is not typed as critical IT, gross facility demand, grid connection, generation nameplate, current load, annual energy, or measured consumption. The supplementary page is not an evidence input here, so the value remains exclusion metadata and creates no capacity row.
metadata.sg6_ai_ready_guardrail: A separate SG6 announcement's AI-ready and compute-intensive-workload language describes design capability and target demand, not an actual installed or committed workload. The supplementary page is not an evidence input here, and no workload or hardware-model row is created.
metadata.supplementary_pages_guardrail: The referenced Bangkok, JH2, and SG6 newsroom pages were not supplied as exact byte-and-header captures for this source-only tranche and therefore are not evidence objects. Their contextual claims cannot change the filing-derived generic lifecycle status or create normalized attributes.
metadata.capacity_guardrail: The captured filing table reports no critical IT, gross facility demand, grid-connection capacity, generation nameplate, current load, annual energy, or measured consumption for these rows, so no capacity row is created.
metadata.classification_guardrail: IBX, customer, interconnection, cloud, AI, and portfolio language elsewhere in the filing does not establish a normalized workload, operating model, tenant, customer, user, or installed hardware model for any listed row.
metadata.location_guardrail: Lagos, Bangkok, Johor, and Singapore are retained as authoritative city or region localities only. The filing does not establish street addresses, parcels, points, footprints, geometries, or unique-site counts.
metadata.role_guardrail: The filer, executives, customers, suppliers, partners, landlords, and investors are not normalized into owner, operator, developer, tenant, customer, user, contractor, investor, utility, or other roles.
metadata.energy_guardrail: The filing supplies no row-specific PUE, energy, grid, generation, renewable-share, or measured-consumption observation for these projects.
metadata.rights_scope: Compact factual extraction under the publisher's all-rights-reserved terms; the captured filing body is not redistributed.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: No satellite imagery, aerial imagery, computer vision, or analyst geolocation contributes to identity, locality, lifecycle, capacity, or classification.
